description: This file defines a PHP trait 'StaticLoggerTrait' used to add static logging capabilities to legacy classes. It provides methods to set and retrieve a logger instance and to log messages at various levels such as debug, info, notice, error, warning, and critical.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the static logger instance used for logging.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the current static logger instance.

methods.name: log
methods.description: General method to log a message with a specified severity level.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a message at the debug level.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs a message at the info level.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Logs a message at the notice level.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs a message at the error level.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Logs a message at the warning level.

methods.name: critical
methods.description: Logs a message at the critical level.
